It was released by Quattro/UK Discs Project in limited quantity in 2002. The album was recorded and mixed at Bazooka Studio, from July to September 2001. It was mastered at Peace Music, January 2002. In 2011, Boris released another album called Heavy Rocks featuring the same cover style in purple. It has its own page at last.fm - Heavy Rocks (2011). Kyuss  (pronounced /ˈkaɪ.əs/ KYE-əs) are the corner stone of what is known as stoner rock or desert rock. Although deriving influence from 60s-70s hard rock, Kyuss churned out a unique sound. This was primarily because guitarist Josh Homme often tuned to a low C, a major third below standard pitch, but also singer John Garcia's paint stripping vocals.

The band was originally formed in 1989 in Palm Desert, California under the name "Sons of Kyuss".

Founded in 1994, Colour Haze is a german Stoner Rock/ Psychedelic Rock band. The band's current lineup includes Stefan Koglek (vocals/guitar), Manfred Merwald (drums) and Philipp Rasthofer (bass). Hailing from Munich, they follow in the tradition of other classic rock trios such as Cream, Grand Funk Railroad and The Jimi Hendrix Experience.

The band's line-up has been restructured since the their inception, but has remained steady since May of 1999.
